summary: Inventory of the Scholar question engine across Learn/Tutor/Exam. Two disjoint question pipelines exist: (a) the interactive "scholar_quiz" MCQ pipeline owned by quiz.ts + quiz-contract.ts + question-grounding.ts, and the two-phase open-response pipeline owned by open-assessment.ts + tool-actions/learning.ts, both driven by the prehook/event handlers in index.ts and bound to section/tutor attempts; (b) the Exam pipeline owned by exam.ts (freeze/parse/grade) + tool-actions/exam.ts (build/present/grade) + render/assessment.ts (paper and answer key), which shares NO code with (a) but re-implements its fairness rules (catch-all ban, distractor misconceptions, option plausibility) and its presentational concepts. Learn and Tutor are almost fully shared (same functions, same attempt shape) with mode differences injected as 4 kinds of branches: the GroundingTarget union (question-grounding.ts:15-17), learnQuestionGrounding (domain.ts:168), the index.ts prehook mode ternaries, and learning.ts handleAssess tutor/learn ternaries. Exam is not a caller of any pipeline (a) function; modes.ts:51-85 and runtime-coordinator.ts:306-307/487-489 make that a capability invariant (assesses=false).
architecture: scholar_quiz (MCQ, Learn+Tutor only): model authors -> quiz.ts NewScholarQuizParams/OptionSchema -> index.ts tool_call prehook (parseScholarQuizInput, assertShortQuestion, learnQuestionGrounding, assertQuestionGrounding, assertLearnFigureCoverage, reviewQuestion, attempts.push) -> quiz.ts prepareScholarQuiz (freeze) -> quiz.ts askChoice (TUI) -> quiz.ts answeredResult/isCorrect (mechanical grading) -> index.ts tool_result maps status->outcome, persists feedback/correctAnswer, appends transcript, recomputeProgress (Learn only). Open response (Learn+Tutor only): assess outcome=pending -> tool-actions/learning.ts handleAssess -> OpenResponseGate capture/evaluate -> grader returns evaluation -> outcome pass/review recorded; state-schema.ts:141 isAttempt validates both formats in one shape. Exam: exam_build -> validateExamQuestions/examFormIssues/examBlueprint (exam.ts) + planExamReviewPackets + handleExamBuild -> presentExam writes Obsidian paper (render/assessment.ts:104) -> learner edits paper -> /scholar exam submit -> validateExamAnswerNote + parseExamResponses (exam.ts:329,356) persists rawResponses -> gradingPacket (exam.ts:434) -> exam_grade -> handleExamGrade validates per-item points/outcome and sums; renderExamAnswerKey prints results.

"quiz" : quizKind(input.details, input.difficulty, currentSection, input.kind), ...})` :382-390 (quizKind domain.ts:244 does keyword inference from `difficulty`/`details` text for Learn only, since `currentSection` is undefined for Tutor) -> `if (currentSection.status === "not-started") currentSection.status = "learning";` :400.

- Feedback text for Learn is the shared one (see §4), plus the Learn completion line.

### Tutor

- MCQ: identical handler, `else` branch `assertQuestionGrounding(input.grounding, book, { mode: "tutor", tutor });` index.ts:352 and index.ts:377; persistence target `currentTutor.attempts` via the same `attempts.push` index.ts:382 (`const attempts = currentSection?.attempts || currentTutor?.attempts;` index.ts:380); transcript target `found.tutor.transcript` index.ts:420/463; on result `else found.tutor.updatedAt = new Date().toISOString();` index.ts:471.

It does not alter Learn completion or Exam evidence.\`, ...) }` learning.ts:383-385; no `recomputeProgress` (:376 is Learn-only).
- Question review for Tutor is the same `reviewQuestion` guarded by `"objectives" in target ? !target.learnQuality : !target.review` tool-controller.ts:216.

### Exam

- Exam never calls any pipeline-(a) function. The tool is not even registered: `if (modeCan(mode, "assesses") && !this.quizRegistered) { registerScholarQuiz(...) }` runtime-coordinator.ts:487-488, and it is filtered out of the active list by `if (this.quizRegistered && modeCan(this.runtimeSession.mode, "assesses"))` :306. `MODE_CAPABILITIES.exam.assesses = false` modes.ts:64.
- `assess` in Exam mode falls into the Learn branch and is rejected by `requireLearnSection` -> `requireMode("learn")` tool-controller.ts:439-440; there is no exam branch in `handleAssess`.
- Create: `exam_build` -> `requireMode("exam")` tool-controller.ts:840 -> `validateExamQuestions(current, (params.questions || []) as ExamQuestion[])` :858 -> `examFormIssues(blueprint)` :860 -> `planExamReviewPackets` :877 -> `handleExamBuild` tool-actions/exam.ts:37 -> `presentExam` :87 (declared `export type PresentExamFn` tool-actions/exam.ts:29-33).
- Present: `exam_present` -> `handleExamPresent` tool-actions/exam.ts:84; paper text built by `examAnswerNoteText` render/assessment.ts:104; answer regions `examAnswerRegionLines` exam.ts:277; checkbox rows `- [ ] **${value}** — ${label} <!-- scholar:choice:${index} -->` exam.ts:284-285.
- Record: learner edits the paper; `/scholar exam submit` -> `submitExam` tool-controller.ts:487 -> `examAnswerProgress` exam.ts:415 -> `parseExamResponses` exam.ts:499 -> `validateExamAnswerNote` exam.ts:329 (called from the submit path) -> `current.rawResponses = rawResponses;` :522.
- Grade: `exam_grade` -> `handleExamGrade` tool-actions/exam.ts:111; grader gets `CORRECT VALUE(S): ${coerceAnswerValues(question.correctAnswer).join(", ")}` exam.ts:440 or the rubric list :442, and `GOLD EXPLANATION: ${question.explanation}` :445; results validated per item (points/outcome consistency tool-actions/exam.ts:150-158) and persisted :179-185; feedback rendered by `gradedQuestionLines` render/assessment.ts:147 and `renderExamAnswerKey` :181.
- Exam-specific differences vs Learn/Tutor: formats are `multiple-choice | open` (tool-contract.ts:52) rather than `scholar_quiz`/`assess`; scoring is points-based with partial credit instead of pass/review/unsure; feedback lives in `ExamItemResult` (`feedback`, `firstDecisiveError`, `correctReasoning`, `transferableLesson` tool-contract.ts:68-77) instead of `attempt.feedback`; grounding is replaced by `scope.sectionIds` membership (`Exam question ${id} must reference only sections in the frozen scope.` exam.ts:169-171); MCQ correctness is model-judged from the grading packet, not mechanically compared.

## 3. Duplicated / near-duplicate question paths

**D1. Catch-all-option ban, implemented twice with the same regex.**
- scholar_quiz side quiz-contract.ts:53-54: `const catchAll = options.find((option) => /\b(all|none|both|any|either|neither)\s+of\s+(the\s+)?(above|these|them|the\s+others)\b/i.test(option.label));` / `` if (catchAll) throw new Error(`scholar_quiz forbids catch-all options such as ${JSON.stringify(catchAll.label)}; ask for a specific decision.`); ``
- Exam side exam.ts:26 + :184-186: `const CATCH_ALL_OPTION = /\b(all|none|both|any|either|neither)\s+of\s+(the\s+)?(above|these|them|the\s+others)\b/i;` / `` throw new Error(`MCQ ${id} uses a catch-all option (${JSON.stringify(catchAll.label)}). The question engine forbids all/none-of-the-above: it tests bookkeeping rather than a decision.`); ``

**D2. Every distractor must declare a distinct misconception, implemented twice.**
- quiz-contract.ts:56-59: `if (distractors.some((option) => !option.misconception?.trim())) throw new Error("Every wrong scholar_quiz option must declare the specific misconception it targets.");` and `if (new Set(diagnoses).size !== diagnoses.length) throw new Error("Each wrong scholar_quiz option must target a distinct misconception.");`
- exam.ts:196-206: `const undiagnosed = distractors.filter((option) => !option.misconception);` ... `` throw new Error(`MCQ ${id} distractor(s) ... declare no misconception. Each distractor must name the one distinct misconception it targets.`); `` and `` throw new Error(`MCQ ${id} repeats a distractor misconception. Each wrong option must target a different error.`); ``

**D3. "Two options is a coin flip" minimum, with different thresholds and different enforcement.**
- scholar_quiz: `Type.Array(OptionSchema, { minItems: 2, ... })` quiz.ts:58 and `if (options.length < 2) throw new Error("scholar_quiz requires at least two options");` quiz.ts:493.
- Exam: `const MIN_MCQ_OPTIONS = 3;` exam.ts:22 and `` throw new Error(`MCQ ${id} needs at least ${MIN_MCQ_OPTIONS} genuinely plausible options; ${rawOptions.length} makes the item a guess rather than a discrimination.`) `` exam.ts:163-165. (The policy asks for 3-4 in both: policies.ts:28 and :113.)

**D4. correctAnswer → option-value resolution, implemented twice.**
- quiz.ts:154-183 `resolveCorrect` maps values to 1-based indices (`const byValue = new Map(options.map((option, index) => [option.value, index + 1]));` :172) and enforces `single-select requires exactly one correctAnswer value` :164 / `multi-select requires at least two correctAnswer values` :167.
- exam.ts:191-193 validates the same relationship but keeps raw values: `const correct = [...new Set(coerceAnswerValues(question.correctAnswer).map((value) => value.trim()))];` / `throw new Error(`MCQ ${id} has an invalid correctAnswer value.`);`; single-vs-multi is enforced at answer time instead: `if (selected.length > 1 && !(Array.isArray(question.correctAnswer) && question.correctAnswer.length > 1)) throw new Error(`Question ${question.id}: select one answer only. ...`)` exam.ts:306-307.
- `coerceCorrectAnswer` (quiz.ts:140) and `coerceAnswerValues` (exam.ts:91) are near-identical helpers: `return value === undefined ? [] : Array.isArray(value) ? value : [value];` exam.ts:92 vs `if (Array.isArray(correctAnswer)) return correctAnswer;` quiz.ts:141.

**D5. MCQ answer collection, two incompatible mechanics.**
- Interactive: quiz.ts:223 `askChoice` with an injected `DONT_KNOW_LABEL = "I don't know"` quiz.ts:27 and `SUBMIT_VALUE` :29, single-select commits on Enter (`if (matchesKey(data, Key.enter) && current.kind !== "submit") chooseSingle(current);` :313), multi-select toggles with Space (:317).
- Exam: `function checkboxResponse(question: ExamQuestion, response: string): string` exam.ts:289 parses `^- \[([ xX])\] .+ <!-- scholar:choice:(\d+) -->\s*$` :297 and returns `selected.join(", ")` :309.

**D6. Open-response grading, two models for the same concept.**
- Learn/Tutor: `isOpenAssessmentContract` = `{ expectedAnswer, criteria }` open-assessment.ts:20-23 with boolean per-criterion `{ criterionIndex, met, evidence?, imageIndex? }` :26-32, and all-or-nothing `outcome: ... ? "pass" : "review"` :150.
- Exam: `ExamRubricSchema` = `{ id, criterion, requiredEvidence, points }` tool-contract.ts:42-47 with `Math.abs(rubricPoints - question.maxPoints) > 0.001` exam.ts:244-246 and continuous `earnedPoints`/`maxPoints` (tool-actions/exam.ts:128-158).

**D7. "Present the question" paths, one per pipeline.**
- MCQ: quiz.ts:553-556 pre-answer update, comment at :551: `This pre-answer update deliberately contains neither the key nor the explanation.`
- Open: learning.ts:301 `Present this approved question exactly, without answer cues:`
- Exam paper: render/assessment.ts:130-132 (`Written response · Show your reasoning.` / `Select one answer.`) fed by exam.ts:263-285.

**D8. Independent question review, two implementations of the same role.**
- Learn/Tutor: `reviewTargetQuestion` review-layer.ts:582, one `"assessment"` pass (`let result = await reviewOne(reviewOpts, "assessment", { value, sourcePages });` :599).
- Exam: `planExamReviewPackets` review-layer.ts:524, also `role: "assessment"` per question with its own instruction text: `"Review this exam question before presentation. Check source grounding, clear wording, unique key, fair distractors, and rubric. Do not leak answer keys or rubrics."` review-layer.ts:534.

**D9. Answer-key / correct-answer text, three renderers.**
- quiz.ts:451-455 verdicts `"User answered correctly."` / `"User answered incorrectly."`; :462 `` `${verdict}\nCorrect: ${correctText}\nExplanation: ${explanation}` ``; TUI result marker logic quiz.ts:592-604.
- index.ts:467 transcript line `` `**Outcome:** ${attempt.outcome === "pass" ? "Correct" : attempt.outcome === "unsure" ? "Knowledge gap identified" : attempt.outcome === "review" ? "Needs review" : attempt.outcome}. ...` ``
- render/assessment.ts:142-145 `displayedCorrectAnswer` (value -> label, exam-only).

**D10. Two "unanswered question" resume behaviours keyed off format.**
- domain.ts:67-68 forks on `pending.format === "multiple-choice"` between `resumeAttemptId` replay and open-response replay; both are Learn/Tutor only.
- Exam cannot be resumed at all: `if (!exam || exam.status !== "submitted") throw new Error("Only a submitted exam can be graded.");` tool-actions/exam.ts:118.

## 4. Feedback and scoring: shared vs forked

**Shared (mode-agnostic):**
- One attempt record shape for MCQ and open in both Learn and Tutor (`isAttempt` state-schema.ts:141-178), with format-conditional fields: `(value.quiz === undefined || (value.format === "multiple-choice" && isFrozenScholarQuiz(value.quiz) ...))` :152-154, `(value.openAssessment === undefined || (value.format === "open" && isOpenAssessmentContract(value.openAssessment)))` :163, `(value.correctAnswer === undefined || ... value.format === "multiple-choice" ...)` :173-175.
- One outcome vocabulary for Learn+Tutor: `"pending" | "pass" | "review" | "unsure" | "cancelled" | "unavailable"` state-schema.ts:166-171.
- One MCQ grading function (`isCorrect` quiz.ts:186) and one frozen-key read-back (`scholarQuizCorrectAnswer` quiz-contract.ts:231) for both modes.
- One open-response receipt/evaluation gate (`OpenResponseGate` open-assessment.ts:73) for both modes; the gate is bound to the mode+record by `JSON.stringify([book.id, book.instanceId, session.mode, session.recordId])` open-assessment.ts:77.
- One question reviewer role (`assessment`) review-layer.ts:599/534.
- One `unansweredQuestionMessage` used by both modes' system prompts (policies.ts:80 area uses `sectionProgressMessage`; `unansweredQuestionMessage(tutor.attempts || [])` policies.ts:170-172) and by the prehook (index.ts:338-339, 381).

**Forked:**
